parse_dataset: parse the Lewis et al. '17 negotiation dialogue dataset file and return instances and negotiations
compute_nbs_from_simulations: compute empirical Nash bargaining score from game simulations using bot agents
write_instances_file: write bargaining problem instances from negotiations to a text file
run_nego_nbs_example: run the full NBS analysis pipeline with human play, max bot, random bot, and IS-MCTS bot
create_maxbot: create a MaxBot agent that selects the NBS-maximizing action in a bargaining game
